profile.headline: Sr Full Stack Developer at CMRIgnite
profile.summary:
Experienced Web Developer specializing in Drupal, WordPress, and Laravel, with a strong background in full-stack development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL). Currently working at CMRignite, I focus on building and optimizing digital experiences for a variety of clients.

I have contributed to large-scale government modernization projects, streamlining website functionality and enhancing content management with component-based development. Recently, I earned a Drupal development certification from Acquia, further solidifying my expertise in the field.

Passionate about creating user-friendly and scalable web solutions, I’m always looking for opportunities to collaborate with dynamic teams and tackle challenging projects.

Let’s connect! Say hello at shawnw@creativeair.co

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Webmaster - Updating web content from word documents, excel files, emails etc. to  specific CMS sites and static sites. CMS's include WordPress, Drupal, DNN (Dotnetnuke) and static HTML sites.

CMS Maintenance - WordPress & Drupal.  Responsible for updating the CMS core and modules.

Email Production - Email marketing utilizing Mailchimp and Campaign Monitor, flowing designs into content for emails.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Website developer & consultant working independently and on term contracts with small to mid-size development teams. I'm involved in planning, development and theming for MVC frameworks and PHP Content Management Systems, as well as website maintenance and Search Engine Optimization.

Responsibilities include:
•	CMS Theming (WordPress, Drupal, Magento, Shopify)
•	Search Optimization + API Integration
•	Collaborate with designers and Scrum/Agile project managers, teams & clients
•	Optimization and Quality Assurance Testing
•	Front-End Prototyping (html/css/js)

positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
Website design, development, search engine optimization and maintenance for an online floral business.

Responsibilities included
•	Front-End Prototyping utilizing Dreamweaver, Adobe Photoshop & Illustrator
•	SEO optimization
•	WordPress Development
•	Blog & Article writing
•	Perform quality assurance test to optimize usability

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description: Conducted daily operations, interviewed and hired staff.  Head of  payroll department, social media marketing, and event planning.

positions.title: Water purification specialist
positions.description:
Performed water quality analysis testing and verification.
Assisted in water reconnaissance and site preparation.
Operated and maintained water treatment equipment.
Assisted in setup of water treatment activity.

positions.title: Manager
positions.description: Led a team of inventory workers in receiving and recording new stock as it came in, moved stock onto trucks and store shelves as needed. Interviewed and hired employees, created schedules, monitored stock level and replenished stock as needed.
